definitions.explanation: An artificial box placed outdoors to provide nesting space for birds.
A box used in beekeeping to house a bee colony.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}に{巣箱|すばこ}を{取|と}り{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I put up a birdhouse in the garden.

examples.japanese: {巣箱|すばこ}にシジュウカラが{入|はい}った。
examples.english: A Japanese tit moved into the nest box.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちと{一緒|いっしょ}に{巣箱|すばこ}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made a birdhouse together with the children.

examples.japanese: {巣箱|すばこ}からハチミツを{採取|さいしゅ}する。
examples.english: To harvest honey from the beehive box.

examples.japanese: {養蜂家|ようほうか}は{巣箱|すばこ}の{管理|かんり}に{気|き}を{使|つか}う。
examples.english: Beekeepers take great care in managing their hive boxes.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{巣箱|すばこ}に{蜂|はち}の{群|む}れを{移|うつ}した。
examples.english: I transferred the bee colony to a new hive box.

notes:
Composed of {巣|す} (nest) + {箱|はこ} (box). The birdhouse sense is more common in everyday conversation, while the beekeeping sense is used in specialized agricultural contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巣箱|すばこ}を{作|つく}る: to make a nest box
- {巣箱|すばこ}を{掛|か}ける: to hang a birdhouse
- {巣箱|すばこ}を{設置|せっち}する: to install a nest box
- {巣箱|すばこ}の{手入|てい}れ: nest box maintenance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鳥|とり}の{巣|す}: bird's nest — a natural nest built by birds themselves
- {巣|す}: nest — the general word for any animal nest
- {養蜂箱|ようほうばこ}: beehive box — a more specific term for beekeeping boxes
